verdict.rationale: Zamzar's pricing page offers 'Test Free (No card required)'. The docs send all example requests to a dedicated sandbox endpoint (sandbox.zamzar.com) that is separate from production, and every API call returns a remaining-credits header, so developers can test conversions before paying. The pricing table also shows a 1MB maximum file size on the lowest tier. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that sandbox jobs perform real conversions, the size of the free credit allowance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the free test flow.
